blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings rose from 10 in June to 14 in September (+40.0%), and it took 3.3% of the city’s 60 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings rose from 106 in June to 108 in September (+1.9%), and it took 22.2% of the city’s 261 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Uptown for detached houses in June, July (a buyers’ best bet).
Uptown share of New Westminster listings and sales by month

In Uptown, its share of the houses listed in New Westminster went from 6.4% in June to 8.5% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 22.3% to 24.3%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

items.t: New Westminster real estate market stats
Uptown condos and townhomes for sale

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Uptown?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 14 houses and 108 condos and townhomes listed in Uptown. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Uptown a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had 12% (a balanced market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Uptown from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 houses and 58 condos and townhomes sold in Uptown over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in June with 1 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in July with 17 sold.

faq.q: How big is Uptown compared with the rest of New Westminster?
faq.a: In September 2026, Uptown held 8.5% of the 164 detached houses listed in New Westminster and 24.3% of the 444 condos and townhomes listed in New Westminster.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Uptown?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 11.5% of the 122 homes listed in Uptown and condos and townhomes made up 88.5%; of the 13 that sold, houses were 0.0% and condos and townhomes 100.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Uptown than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses rose from 10 in June to 14 in September 2026 (+40.0%); condos and townhomes rose from 106 in June to 108 in September 2026 (+1.9%).
